assertion.statement: cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages, and v1.16.5 is the last release available on OperatorHub (both the RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io).

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence does not say how to tell whether an environment installed cert-manager from OperatorHub/OLM, and it names no resource, value or setting that a predicate could read.; consequence: The evidence says only that v1.16.5 is the last OperatorHub release. It does not say what happens to existing OperatorHub installations, or what migration path they should take.
